fill.recent project: As Head of Growth and Design at Gramrphone, a music-tech startup, I owned growth end to end with a very small team. I mapped the funnel from acquisition through onboarding to retention, set up the analytics, and ran a programme of A/B tests on landing pages, onboarding and lifecycle messaging. The biggest win was redesigning onboarding: it became four times faster and downloads-to-installs rose six-fold. Because I design and write front-end code myself, I could ship experiments the same day rather than waiting on engineering. Before that, at CryptoKnowledge, I built the brand, website and content and ran the Facebook Ads funnels that filled the course, optimising CPA week by week. That's the founding-marketer pattern I'd bring to Magentic: find the channel that works, build the assets and measure everything.
